title: Inverse distance ladder: H0 from DESI DR2 BAO plus a BBN omega_b prior
stage: preregistration (no fit of this problem has been run)

prereg_helper.note: Pure formula evaluation and file hashing; no BAO data are fitted.

model.flat_prior_source: arXiv:2404.03002 Table 2 (adopted by arXiv:2503.14738 Sec. V)

bbn_prior.source: arXiv:2503.14738 eq. 14 = arXiv:2404.03002 eq. 2.8 = arXiv:2401.15054 eq. 5.1 (PRyMordial NACRE II, PDG abundances)

model.omega_m_convention: Omega_m includes the massive neutrino (DESI/Planck convention). omega_cb = Omega_m h^2 - omega_nu, omega_nu = 0.0107*0.06 (Aubourg text below eq. 16). astropy Om0 = Omega_m - Onu0.
model.background: astropy FlatLambdaCDM(H0, Om0=Omega_m-Onu0, Tcmb0=2.7255, Neff=3.044, m_nu=[0.06,0,0]) primary; independent manual integrator coded without astropy: photons (T=2.7255 K) + the massless-nu share of N_eff as radiation, the 0.06 eV nu treated as pure matter (inside Omega_m) at z<=2.33; must agree with astropy to <1e-4 fractional on all observables (if the matter approximation misses this, it is reported, not tuned away)
model.r_d_primary: Aubourg et al. 2015 arXiv:1411.1074 eq. 16 (CAMB convention; stated accuracy 0.021% for N_eff=3.046, sum m_nu<0.6 eV, omega_b and omega_cb within 3 sigma of Planck)
model.r_d_sensitivity_variant: DESI DR2 arXiv:2503.14738 eq. 2 power law (accuracy not stated in source); reported alongside, not used for PASS/FAIL
model.radiation_sensitivity_variant: same fit with radiation removed from H(z); reported only
model.sampler: emcee, 32 walkers, run until integrated autocorrelation time tau satisfies N_steps > 50*tau for all params, discard 5*tau burn-in; ESS >= 2000
model.reported_statistic: posterior mean and standard deviation (matches arXiv:2503.14738 Table V caption); MAP also reported but not used for PASS/FAIL

targets.name: H0_DESI_DR2_BAO_plus_BBN
targets.source: arXiv:2503.14738 eq. (19) and Table V row DESI+BBN (no CMB theta*)
targets.note: Sec. IX text says 68.50; eq. 19/Table V value 68.51 used

targets.name: DR1_BAO_only_gate
targets.note: arXiv:2404.03002 gives r_d h = 101.8 +- 1.3 in Sec. 8 (p. 46) but 101.9 +- 1.3 in Sec. 6 (p. 36); 101.8 used (conclusions; same value as the prior bao_flcdm comparison); difference 0.08 sigma.

explicitly_not_targets: DR1 DESI+BBN+theta* 68.52 +- 0.62 (2404.03002 eq. 4.5; the DR1 abstract number)

systematic_budget.rd_formula_strict_justification: Eq. 16 vs a sourced CAMB model (Planck 2018 Table 1 Plik best fit, r_drag=147.049): -0.020% (matches the stated 0.021%). Eq. 2 fed its pivot convention (nu-inclusive Omega_m h^2) at the same anchor: -0.016%. Eq. 2 vs eq. 16 at DESI's DR2 DESI+BBN centre: -0.053%. Anchor B hr_d offset (eq. 16) -0.077% (0.11 sigma of hr_d; loose, a function of means). Rounded up to 0.10% to cover the part of the BBN omega_b prior outside eq. 16's validity window (BBN +-2 sigma [0.02108,0.02328] exceeds the Planck-2018-proxy 3 sigma window [0.02191,0.02281]); this value is a PROXY, not a quoted accuracy.
systematic_budget.rd_formula_conservative_justification: max |eq.2(omega_cb+omega_nu) - eq.16(omega_cb)|/eq.16 over omega_b in BBN +-3 sigma and omega_cb in [0.130,0.155] = 0.233%; box corners lie outside eq. 16's validity window and eq. 2's accuracy is not stated in any fetched source, so this is a deliberately conservative bound.
systematic_budget.propagation: dH0/H0 = -(d r_d/r_d)/0.493 (h r_d ~ h^(1-2*0.2535) at fixed Omega_m)
systematic_budget.sigma_mc_justification: posterior-mean MC error ~0.58/sqrt(ESS~1000) = 0.02 for DESI and ours, rounding 0.005, background-model differences (<1e-4 fractional in distances), prior-volume treatment identical by construction

tolerance.non_independence_note: Same data vector, same BBN prior and same flat priors as DESI, so sigma_pub is NOT independent noise on the difference. The tolerance is therefore built from the systematic budget, not from sigma_pub.

verdicts.PASS: |H0 - 68.51| <= 0.15 AND |Omega_m - 0.2977| <= 0.25*0.0086 AND sigma(H0) within +-15% of 0.58 AND gate G1 passed AND all controls behave
verdicts.PARTIAL: 0.15 < |H0 - 68.51| <= 0.33 (consistent only within the conservative formula systematic), other conditions as PASS
verdicts.FAIL: |H0 - 68.51| > 0.33, or sigma(H0) outside +-15%, or Omega_m condition fails, or gate G1 fails, or any control misbehaves

tolerance.second_check_T2: same strict/soft H0 thresholds (0.15/0.33 km/s/Mpc) against 68.53; sigma(H0) within +-15% of 0.80; |Omega_m - 0.295| <= 0.25*0.015. Reported separately; headline verdict is T1.
tolerance.gate_G1: |Omega_m - 0.2975| <= 0.25*0.0086 and |hr_d - 101.54| <= 0.25*0.73 and posterior sigmas within +-15%, using posterior means from an (Omega_m, hr_d) run with DR1-Table-2 flat priors (hr_d U[10,1000]). If G1 fails, the H0 result is reported but labelled instrument-unvalidated.

positive_controls.description: Noiseless mock: DR2 data vector generated by our own predictor at (H0=68.0, Omega_m=0.300, omega_b=0.02218) with DR2 covariance; full MCMC with BBN prior.
positive_controls.pass_if: posterior mean H0 within 0.1 km/s/Mpc of 68.0 and Omega_m within 0.002 of 0.300 (noiseless => only prior-volume/projection offsets)

positive_controls.description: 100 noisy mocks drawn from N(model, C_DR2) at the same truth; MAP fit each (MCMC too costly for 100).
positive_controls.pass_if: mean pull (H0_hat-68.0)/sigma_hat within +-0.2 and pull standard deviation in [0.8, 1.2]

positive_controls.description: Gate G1: DR2 BAO-only reproduction of the published Omega_m and hr_d (external positive control against DESI's own CAMB pipeline).
Predictor cross-check: astropy vs manual integrator on all 13 observables at 3 parameter points.

negative_controls.description: Scrambled data vector: randomly permute the 13 DR2 values among (z, quantity) slots (fixed seed 20260927), keep covariance.
negative_controls.control_behaves_if: scrambled data: best-fit chi2 PTE < 1e-3 (while the real data must give PTE > 0.01)

negative_controls.description: Wrong model: matter-only Einstein-de Sitter (Omega_m=1, flat) with free H0 and BBN omega_b, on real DR2 data.
negative_controls.control_behaves_if: EdS model on real data: best-fit chi2 PTE < 1e-3

negative_controls.description: Degeneracy control: remove the BBN prior (omega_b flat U[0.005,0.1] only).
negative_controls.control_behaves_if: without BBN prior: posterior sigma(H0) > 5x baseline sigma(H0) (H0 not identified without calibration)

report_rules: Controls P1-P4 and N1-N4 run and are reported before the T1/T2 comparison is shown.
Only real tool output is reported; a stage that cannot run is reported BLOCKED with reason.
No change to tolerance, priors, formula choice or statistic after the first fit output; any deviation is logged as a deviation with reason.
Fit code goes under scripts/bao_bbn_h0/, outputs under results/bao_bbn_h0/.

p_success_prior.reasoning: PASS = H0 within 0.15 AND Omega_m within 0.25 sigma AND sigma(H0) within 15% AND G1 passes AND all controls behave. Same data/prior as DESI; the only new ingredient is the r_d formula (-0.020% vs CAMB at the Planck anchor; unmeasured over the low-omega_b part of the BBN prior and vs DESI's newer CAMB, which is not installed here). Residual risks: posterior-mean projection effects, sampler convergence, and the tight 0.25 sigma G1 gate.

lean_plan: formal/ANSE/BAO_BBN_H0.lean (later stage): positivity and strict antitonicity of A*x^(-a)*b^(-c) in x>0; H0 = 100 h; h*r_d(h) strictly increasing in h for 1-2a>0. In-file #print axioms; pinned imports as formal/ANSE/BAO_FlatLCDM.lean; gate via anse/formal/lean_runner.py.
